description: This file defines mock classes for the IHdmiCecSink interface used in testing HDMI CEC sink functionality. It includes mock methods for various operations and notifications related to HDMI CEC, such as device management, media control, and status reporting.

classes.name: HdmiCecSinkMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the IHdmiCecSink interface for unit testing HDMI CEC sink functionalities.

classes.name: HdmiCecSinkNotificationMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the IHdmiCecSink::INotification interface for testing HDMI CEC notifications.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Mocks the registration of a notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Mocks the unregistration of a notification callback.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Mocks configuration of the HDMI CEC sink with a service.

methods.name: GetActiveRoute
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of the current active HDMI CEC route.

methods.name: GetActiveSource
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of the current active HDMI source details.

methods.name: GetAudioDeviceConnectedStatus
methods.description: Mocks fetching the audio device connection status.

methods.name: GetDeviceList
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of the list of connected HDMI devices.

methods.name: GetEnabled
methods.description: Mocks checking whether HDMI CEC is enabled.

methods.name: GetOSDName
methods.description: Mocks fetching the On-Screen Display name.

methods.name: GetVendorId
methods.description: Mocks fetching the vendor ID.

methods.name: PrintDeviceList
methods.description: Mocks printing the list of connected devices.

methods.name: RequestActiveSource
methods.description: Mocks requesting to activate the current source.

methods.name: RequestShortAudioDescriptor
methods.description: Mocks requesting short audio descriptors.

methods.name: SendAudioDevicePowerOnMessage
methods.description: Mocks sending power-on message to audio device.

methods.name: SendGetAudioStatusMessage
methods.description: Mocks sending a request for audio status.

methods.name: SendKeyPressEvent
methods.description: Mocks sending a key press event.

methods.name: SendUserControlPressed
methods.description: Mocks sending a user control (button) pressed event.

methods.name: SendUserControlReleased
methods.description: Mocks releasing a user control (button).

methods.name: SendStandbyMessage
methods.description: Mocks sending a standby message.

methods.name: SetActivePath
methods.description: Mocks setting the active HDMI path.

methods.name: SetActiveSource
methods.description: Mocks setting the device as active source.

methods.name: SetEnabled
methods.description: Mocks enabling or disabling HDMI CEC.

methods.name: SetMenuLanguage
methods.description: Mocks setting the menu language.

methods.name: SetOSDName
methods.description: Mocks setting the On-Screen Display name.

methods.name: SetRoutingChange
methods.description: Mocks changing routing from old to new port.

methods.name: SetupARCRouting
methods.description: Mocks setting up ARC (Audio Return Channel) routing.

methods.name: SetVendorId
methods.description: Mocks setting the vendor ID.

methods.name: SetLatencyInfo
methods.description: Mocks setting latency and audio output delay information.
